about: DESIGN_SYSTEMS_CONFIG_DIR values and the folder each must resolve to, run by tools/test_routes.py (server/provider_store.py) and web/lib/provider-api.test.ts (web/lib/provider-store.ts) so both stores name the same provider.db. <HOME> is the test's home folder, <REPO> the checkout, <REPO_SWAPCASE> the checkout with the letter case of its last part swapped, <LINK> a symlink the test makes that points at the checkout; "error" means the store refuses the value. "error-if-case-insensitive" means refused where the filesystem ignores case and resolved as typed elsewhere.
